notes.title: Early Access Patch_1
notes.content:
"Your Turn To Die" is in Early Access, which means we're actively working on it based on our plans and your feedback. We expect to keep adding contents, while expanding the story and fine-tuning all aspects of the experience. Here are our latest patch note!

[h2]Bug fix:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed "Scar-a Chidouin" achievement bugs.
[*]Changed "mini episodes" to "past episodes" for better clarification of the contents.
[*]Changed few achievements which contained spoilers
[/list]
We appreciate all of your feedback and support!
Now it's your turn to enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42872934/b3ac2d6cc590386094b99b8935c50ee369dba199.png[/img]

notes.title: Early Access starts on Feb 20th PST!
notes.content:
[b]"Your Turn To Die -Death Game By Majority" will start early access on February 20th PST!
[/b]
[h3]What is "Your Turn To Die"?[/h3]
"Your Turn To Die -Death Game By Majority-" is a multi-ending horror adventure game. Your decision will directly affect the story and final outcome!

[h3]Story[/h3]
Sara Chidouin returns home from school late one night to discover that something's gone terribly wrong. When she comes to, she finds herself, her friend Joe, and 9 other people trapped in a mysterious place. Placed in life-and-death situations, they must come to an agreement about what they should do - and who should die.

[h3]Early Access Specials[/h3]
[list]
[*]Available up to the Final Chapter, Part One(B), [b]main story is NOT yet finished[/b].
[*]The last part of final chapter will be added as soon as it is completed, and those who have purchased the Early Access can play it immediately.
[*]Added the [b]Steam exclusive mini episodes[/b], which are prequels of some of the characters. More episodes will be added in the future!
[*][b]The spcial art book[/b] is added to the game!
[/list]

[previewyoutube=YZknE8bmROU;full][/previewyoutube]
